game: Dune — The Battle for Arrakis, Sega Genesis USA

source.method: Original game procedures on an offline CPU snapshot; 1088 sprite compositor and original VDP pixel renderer on independent CPU copies; source-pixel crops at native resolution.
source.paletteCoverage: Observed native Atreides menu palette from the supplied first-mission CPU snapshot (house1). Other houses UI palette variants are not claimed.
source.transparency: Only isolated focus sprites use native 4bpp nonzero-nibble alpha. Chrome/button crops remain opaque, including intentional native black areas.
